building_id=cat['http://buildgraph.org/BG_medium_office_2004_0000#ElectricMeter']
print(len(zone_ids), building_id)

# load values
vals={}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    rd=csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in rd:
        if row['timestamp'].startswith('2018-07-07'):
            vals.setdefault(row['timeseries_id'],[]).append(float(row['value']))

zone_energy_Wsum={t:sum(vals[t]) for t in zone_ids if t in vals}
lighting_J=sum(zone_energy_Wsum.values())*3600.0
building_J=sum(vals[building_id]) if building_id in vals else None
print("zone present", sum(1 for t in zone_ids if t in vals))
